purpose: Verify complete complaint submission records category, description, timestamp, assigns a unique complaint ID, and returns confirmation.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant account exists.
action_or_input: Submit a complaint with valid category, description, and no attachments.
expected_result: Complaint is accepted and persisted with recorded category, description, submission date/time, a unique complaint identifier, and submission confirmation is returned.

purpose: Verify mandatory complaint fields are validated before accepting a complaint submission.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant account exists.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit complaints missing category or missing description.
expected_result: Submission is rejected/refused and no complaint record is created.

purpose: Verify supporting attachments meeting configured file-type, size, and count constraints are accepted with a complaint submission.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant account exists and valid attachment constraints are configured.
action_or_input: Submit a complaint with valid supporting attachment(s) matching configured extension, size, and count limits.
expected_result: Complaint and attachment metadata/files are accepted and stored.

purpose: Verify attachments violating configured file-type, file-size, or count constraints are rejected before acceptance.
preconditions: Authenticated User / Complainant account exists and attachment limits are configured.
action_or_input: Attempt to submit a complaint with a disallowed file extension, oversized file, or excess attachment count.
expected_result: Submission/attachment is refused and rejected without persisting invalid attachment.

purpose: Verify Complaint Handler can manually assign, categorize, and set Low/Medium/High priority on a submitted complaint and record these details.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler exists and a complaint is in Submitted state.
action_or_input: Handler sets operational assignment, category, and priority (Low, Medium, or High) on the submitted complaint.
expected_result: Assignment and priority details are persisted on the complaint for downstream handling, reminders, and escalation.

purpose: Verify invalid priority values outside Low, Medium, and High are rejected.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler exists and a submitted complaint exists.
action_or_input: Attempt to assign a priority value other than Low, Medium, or High.
expected_result: Request is refused with a validation error and complaint priority remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify complainant tracking and handler review/progress updates maintain complete status and progress history throughout lifecycle.
preconditions: Submitted complaint exists with assigned Complaint Handler and owning Complainant.
action_or_input: Handler reviews assigned complaint and adds progress updates; Complainant queries complaint status and history.
expected_result: Both status history and progress history entries are preserved chronologically and visible to the owning Complainant.

purpose: Verify a complainant cannot track or access another user's private complaint status or history.
preconditions: Two distinct Complainants exist; Complainant A owns a submitted complaint.
action_or_input: Complainant B requests details/history of Complainant A's complaint.
expected_result: Access is refused and Complainant A's complaint data is not disclosed.

purpose: Verify Complaint Handler can resolve a complaint with required resolution details and notify the Complainant.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and an unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler marks the complaint as Resolved with resolution details.
expected_result: Complaint transitions to Resolved, resolution details and status history are recorded, and outcome/status notification trigger is created.

purpose: Verify Complaint Handler can reject a complaint with required rejection reason and notify the Complainant.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and an unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler rejects the complaint with rejection details/reason.
expected_result: Complaint transitions to Rejected, rejection reason and status history are recorded, and outcome/status notification trigger is created.

purpose: Verify resolving or rejecting a complaint without required outcome details is refused.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler and an unresolved complaint exist.
action_or_input: Handler attempts to resolve without resolution details or reject without rejection reason.
expected_result: Action is refused and complaint status remains unchanged.

purpose: Verify resolved complaint closure via Complainant verification or Supervisor verification records Closed status.
preconditions: A complaint is in Resolved status and closure verification mode is configured (complainant or supervisor).
action_or_input: Authorized verifier (Complainant or Supervisor per configuration) confirms closure verification.
expected_result: Complaint status transitions to Closed and closure is recorded in lifecycle history.

purpose: Verify Complainant can request reopening of a closed complaint and Supervisor can approve or deny it, recording the decision and updating status.
preconditions: A complaint is in Closed status; owning Complainant and active Complaint Supervisor exist.
action_or_input: Complainant submits a reopening request; Supervisor reviews and approves (and in a separate check denies) the request.
expected_result: Reopening decision is recorded; approval reopens the complaint to the configured active state and triggers notification; denial keeps complaint Closed.

purpose: Verify Complainant can submit feedback after resolution or closure and Handler/Supervisor can review submitted feedback.
preconditions: A complaint is in Resolved or Closed status.
action_or_input: Owning Complainant submits feedback; Complaint Handler and Complaint Supervisor retrieve/review feedback.
expected_result: Feedback is persisted, notification event is triggered where applicable, and both Handler and Supervisor can view the feedback.

purpose: Verify manual escalation of an unresolved complaint records escalation status and allows Supervisor oversight.
preconditions: An unresolved complaint exists along with active Complaint Supervisor.
action_or_input: Authorized actor manually escalates the unresolved complaint; Complaint Supervisor views escalated complaints.
expected_result: Escalation status is recorded, escalation notification is triggered, and complaint appears in Supervisor escalated complaints view.

purpose: Verify priority-based SLA processing triggers pre-breach reminder notifications and automatically escalates breached unresolved complaints without hardcoded durations.
preconditions: SLA durations are configured; unresolved complaints with assigned priority exist past reminder threshold and past breach threshold.
action_or_input: Execute SLA processing task.
expected_result: Pre-breach reminder notification is triggered for approaching complaint; breached complaint is automatically escalated and escalation notification is triggered.

purpose: Verify Handler and Supervisor can publish announcements, Complainants can view them, and announcement notifications are triggered.
preconditions: Active Complaint Handler, Complaint Supervisor, and Complainant accounts exist.
action_or_input: Handler and Supervisor publish complaint-related announcements; Complainant lists/views announcements.
expected_result: Announcements are persisted, visible to Complainants, and announcement notification trigger events are created.

purpose: Verify plain User / Complainant is refused permission to publish announcements.
preconditions: Authenticated plain User / Complainant without Handler or Supervisor role.
action_or_input: Plain User attempts to publish an announcement.
expected_result: Request is refused with authorization error and no announcement is created.

purpose: Verify role-scoped complaint reports, complaint summaries, escalation summaries, and analytics visibility for Handler, Supervisor, and System Admin.
preconditions: Sample complaints and escalations exist; Handler, Supervisor, System Admin, and plain User accounts exist.
action_or_input: Each role queries CMS reports/summaries/analytics endpoints.
expected_result: Handler accesses operational reports, Supervisor accesses complaint and escalation summaries, System Admin accesses CMS reports/analytics, and plain User is refused.

purpose: Verify CMS records email notification trigger events for submission, status update, resolution, rejection, escalation, reopening, feedback, and announcements without external email delivery.
preconditions: Configured CMS environment.
action_or_input: Execute submission, status update, resolution, rejection, escalation, reopening outcome, feedback, and announcement actions.
expected_result: Corresponding CMS notification trigger records/events are persisted for each event within CMS boundary.

purpose: Verify System Admin can assign and reassign time-bounded Complaint Handler and Complaint Supervisor roles while enforcing at most one active holder per role.
preconditions: System Admin and institutional user accounts exist.
action_or_input: System Admin assigns Handler and Supervisor roles with durations, then reassigns each role mid-cycle to another user.
expected_result: Roles are assigned and reassigned cleanly, and at all times at most one active Handler and one active Supervisor exist.

purpose: Verify CMS confines functionality strictly to complaint-handling scope and exposes no excluded cross-module HR, payroll, accounting, procurement, or platform account administration endpoints.
preconditions: CMS URLs and permission manifest are loaded.
action_or_input: Inspect registered CMS routes and permissions.
expected_result: Only complaint-handling, role-appointment, announcement, feedback, escalation, and reporting capabilities exist.
